decisions.decision: One serial Sonnet worker for groups 1-4 (20 tasks) rather than the parallel split tasks.md permits for groups 1 and 2.
decisions.why: handlers.go and history.go are disjoint so a split is legal, but the gateway doc pack is the largest in the repo (base + htmx-conventions + htmx-go-integration + AGENTS.md) and each parallel worker would re-read all of it. With the 5-hour bucket already at 80% the duplicated pack read costs more than the serialisation saves. Group 3's tests depend on groups 1-2 anyway.
